title: PPT Creator
description: Create professional slide decks from topics or documents. Generates structured content with data-driven charts, speaker notes, and complete PPTX files. Applies persuasive storytelling principles (Pyramid Principle, assertion-evidence). Supports multiple formats. Use for presentations, pitches, slide decks, or keynotes.
claude_description: This skill should be used when the user asks to create a presentation, make slides, build a PPT deck, generate a pitch deck, or produce slide content. Trigger for requests like "make a presentation", "create a deck", "build slides", "PPT on X", or "presentation about Y".
copilot_cli_intro: Create professional slide decks from topics. Generates structured content with data-driven charts, speaker notes, and complete PPTX files using Pyramid Principle and assertion-evidence style.
copilot_rules: Apply Pyramid Principle: conclusion first, then evidence.
Use assertion-style headings (complete sentences) not topic labels.
Generate 45-60 second speaker notes per slide.
Self-evaluate with rubric; refine if score < 75.
copilot_avoid: Using topic labels instead of assertion headings
Packing too much text on a single slide
Waffling instead of using structured storytelling
vscode_intro: Generate professional slide decks from topics using structured storytelling and data visualization.
vscode_rules: Generate data-driven charts when data is available.
instruction_rules: Create slide decks using Pyramid Principle and assertion-evidence style.
Gather minimal intake and apply safe defaults when information is missing.
Generate structured outline → slide content → charts → speaker notes.
Self-evaluate and refine if quality score < 75.
Package complete deliverables with reuse instructions.
prompt_intro: Create a professional slide deck from the given topic. Apply Pyramid Principle, assertion-evidence design, and data visualization best practices.
prompt_checklist: Structure the story with Pyramid Principle.
Create 12-15 slide outline with assertion headings.
Select appropriate charts for data points.
Generate speaker notes for each slide.
